hero.title: Dar Zellij
hero.subtitle: The soul of Morocco in every plate
hero.description: Down a quiet alley of the medina, follow the scent of cumin, saffron and orange blossom. A host table where tradition is savored in every bite.

about.title: Our Story
about.text1: Set inside a 17th-century riad, Dar Zellij carries on recipes handed down from mother to daughter across three generations. Our dishes simmer slowly, honoring the gestures of the past.
about.text2: From Majorelle-blue zellij tiles to hand-chased lanterns, every detail immerses you in Moroccan craftsmanship. On Fridays, our seven-vegetable couscous brings families and travelers together around one table.

menu.title: Our Menu
